_how_to_add_a_feed: Copy any entry below, change name/url/category, and save. type is 'rss' (any RSS or Atom feed) or 'pubmed' (a PubMed search term). Set filter to true for general news feeds so only transplant/kidney articles are kept. The page updates on the next run (every 30 minutes).

feeds.name: PubMed: transplant, donation & kidney failure research
feeds.term: ("kidney transplantation"[MeSH] OR "tissue and organ procurement"[MeSH] OR "living donors"[MeSH] OR "kidney failure, chronic"[MeSH] OR "organ transplantation"[MeSH]) AND hasabstract

feeds.name: PubMed: transplant policy & organ procurement
feeds.term: ("organ procurement organization*"[tiab] OR "organ allocation"[tiab] OR "allocation policy"[tiab] OR "organ discard"[tiab] OR "OPTN"[tiab] OR "transplant policy"[tiab] OR "health policy"[MeSH] AND transplantation[MeSH])

feeds.name: PubMed: living organ donation
feeds.term: ("living donors"[MeSH] OR "living donor"[tiab] OR "living kidney donation"[tiab] OR "living donation"[tiab]) AND hasabstract
